This is a fresh acceptance for phoenix/v0.4-rc.1, not an inherited waiver; it explicitly continues without the runner after v0.3-rc.1 required a new decision for any later cut. SDK tarballs, OCI images, APK packages, hosted CVM deployment and chains other than 42161 and 8453 are not covered by this draft.

deployments (policy v0.14, R5b): the Distribution's deployment sets, keyed by chain and then by label. Each set maps every pinned component to where it runs on that chain: a contract component to its contract addresses (the same addresses the component records carry, which stay the home of codehash, commit and chain fork), a service component to the endpoint URL its covered routes are served from, and a component nobody deploys to null. Exactly one set per chain has the role canonical; it is the only set any partner-facing projection reads. This cut has one set per chain. A staging or dark-launch set on the same chain would be a second label beside it.
